name: Retail
summary: Smart retail solutions that drive growth and sales.
description: Retail and e-commerce UI UX design for storefronts, checkout and seller tools: product pages, carts and loyalty flows that make buying simple for shoppers.
image_alt: Shopper paying online with a credit card, retail industry
overview:
In retail, every extra step costs a sale. Shoppers leave when they cannot find a product, do not trust the price or get lost in checkout. My job is to make browsing clear and buying simple, with honest prices and no surprises at the last step.

I work with founders and product teams on web and mobile retail products, from the first prototype to a design system engineers can build from directly. On Shelfie, a storefront builder for small retailers, I simplified product listing and checkout for non-technical sellers. I design for both sides of the shop: the people buying and the people selling.

challenges.title: Checkout abandonment
challenges.text: Long forms, surprise costs and forced sign-ups make shoppers leave with a full cart.

challenges.title: Finding products
challenges.text: Weak search, filters and categories hide products people would happily buy.

challenges.title: Trust at checkout
challenges.text: Prices, delivery times and return policies have to be clear before people pay.

challenges.title: Non-technical sellers
challenges.text: Store owners need to list products and manage orders without a learning curve.

faqs.question: Do you have experience designing retail products?
faqs.answer: Yes. I designed Shelfie, a storefront builder for small retailers, where I simplified product listing and checkout for non-technical sellers. You can see it in the case studies on this page.

faqs.question: How do you approach checkout design?
faqs.answer: I start by mapping every step and field, then remove what is not needed. Costs, delivery and returns are shown early, and guest checkout is the default where possible.

faqs.question: Can you design seller and admin tools as well as the storefront?
faqs.answer: Yes. I design both sides, so product listing, inventory and order tools share the same system as the shopper-facing screens.

faqs.question: Can you work with Shopify or another existing platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can design within the limits of your platform and theme, or design a custom storefront for your engineers to build.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Send me a short brief through the contact page. We will have a call about your product, users and timeline, and I will come back with a plan and quote.
